plugins.name: dma-insights
plugins.description: The six Digital Maturity Assessment skills, 47 DMA agents, the remote DMA Insights MCP connector (33 tools), and the research ENGINE that makes a run finish unattended: the scoring workbook is the substrate every step writes to, not an export produced once at the end, and the three deliverables — workbook, Assessment Report, Client Research Profile — each have a producer and a reader. See docs/END-TO-END.md for the run, and scripts/aud_ledger.py for what is closed and what is not.
